_comment: ITEM 4 — 把后端 KG 检索与模拟采访以 MCP (stdio, 官方 mcp SDK/FastMCP) 暴露给 deer-flow 2.0 harness。此文件是 OPT-IN 注册：harness 通过 DEER_FLOW_EXTENSIONS_CONFIG_PATH 指向它才会加载（否则走各自默认 extensions_config.json，互不影响）。DEGRADE-SAFETY: bridge 深度研究常在任何图谱/模拟存在之前就跑，故两台服务器都被设计成启动与 tools/list 绝不触碰 FalkorDB/Graphiti/模拟 IPC，工具在图谱/存储缺失时返回结构化错误 {ok:false,error} 且绝不 hang——即便被提早拉起也不会拖垮研究。推荐由编排层只在图谱/模拟已就绪时把 DEER_FLOW_EXTENSIONS_CONFIG_PATH 指向本文件（并按需用 DRF_MCP_KG_GRAPH_ID / DRF_MCP_SIM_ID 注入默认 id）。本文件是模板：command / PYTHONPATH 里的双花括号占位符 DRF_BACKEND_PYTHON（运行后端的解释器）与 DRF_REPO_ROOT（本机仓库根）由编排层 _sync_deerflow_bridge_if_stale 部署到 deer-flow/ 时替换为真实路径，勿写死本机绝对路径。command 用 backend venv 的 python，PYTHONPATH 指向 backend 使 `python -m app.mcp.*` 能解析 `app` 包（-m 只把 CWD 加 sys.path，harness 可能把 stdio 子进程 cwd 定到 thread workspace）。

drf-kg.description: DRF knowledge-graph engine wrapping app.services.zep_tools.ZepToolsService: kg_search (hybrid semantic + BM25, optional point-in-time as_of), kg_trace_cascade (source->target causal paths / center N-hop neighborhood), kg_entity_summary, kg_get_entities, kg_centrality_priors (deterministic degree centrality), kg_graph_statistics. Optional per-tool graph_id; server default via --graph-id / DRF_MCP_KG_GRAPH_ID. Absent graph/FalkorDB -> structured error, never hangs.

drf-simulation.description: DRF simulation engine wrapping app.services.simulation_runner.SimulationRunner: sim_status (run state + health + interview_ready), sim_results (timeline + top-agent stats + run_summary), sim_interview_agents (batch / single / all, live-only). Optional per-tool sim_id; server default via --sim-id / DRF_MCP_SIM_ID. Dead/absent simulation env -> structured error immediately, never hangs the full timeout.
